name: WANTED: Caliph Scorpidsting
summary: Across Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, notices call for Caliph Scorpidsting, leader of the Wastewander outlaws. The Gadgetzan Water Company seeks proof of his death in Gadgetzan.

sections.title: The Company's Charges
sections.body: In Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, the Gadgetzan Water Company posts a high bounty for Caliph Scorpidsting. The notices accuse him of murdering company employees, stealing its resources and seizing its property. Bring proof of his death to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

sections.title: What the Water Company Hopes For
sections.body: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle calls Scorpidsting's death justice and a mighty blow against the Wastewanders. He calls them vile nomads and squatters. The engineer hopes the bounty, paid for the company, will drive them from Gadgetzan's water wells at last.

faq.answer: Caliph Scorpidsting leads the Wastewander outlaws and is wanted by the Gadgetzan Water Company.

faq.q: Why does the Gadgetzan Water Company want him dead?
faq.answer: The company accuses him of murdering its employees, stealing its resources and seizing its property.

faq.q: Who pays the bounty for Caliph Scorpidsting?
aliases: where to turn in caliph head
faq.answer: The Gadgetzan Water Company pays the bounty. Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan takes proof of Scorpidsting's death.

faq.q: Where are the wanted posters located?
aliases: where to pick up caliph bounty
faq.answer: The wanted notices are in Gadgetzan and at Steamwheedle Port.
